summary: #smallpoems What do we mean when we say make meaning? to mean is to have intention to seek to signify can we make intentions? a novel invention of thought caught sign to convey pine to parlay? to give form to a new a norm answers sought a knowledge clot?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
What do we mean
when we
say make meaning?
to mean is to have intention
to seek to signify
can we make intentions?
a novel invention of
thought caught
sign to convey
pine to parlay?
to give form
to a new a norm
answers sought a
knowledge clot?
